SQL:
SELECT ACCT_NO, ACCT_NM, BAL_AMT
FROM TB_ACCT
WHERE MEMB_CD = :MEMB_CD

IN:
MEMB_CD 회원코드

OUT:
ACCT_NO 계좌번호
ACCT_NM 계좌명
BAL_AMT 잔액 LONG
